description: Shows or hides the question area of the live room, so participants can ask questions during the webinar or cannot. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Every participant sees the change on the next load; questions already asked stay stored. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and `status`. For reading and answering the questions use wi_get_webinar_questions and wi_answer_webinar_question.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

status.description: show puts the question area in the room, hide takes it out.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_qa
title: Switch the live questions on or off
